scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm run dev:web:wait"
scripts.dev:web:wait: node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.smoke: npm --prefix server run seed && npm start
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm --prefix web run test
